# Note on 2026

Workshop plan for 2026 is a bit different and we are running a hodgepodge of topics.  Part of the rationale is the changing landscape brought by AI and us trying to figure out what skills we need in this new landscape.

-----


# Workshop Structure

There will be four independent(-ish) modules (9am- ~12pm).  Depending on the presenter, disseminating of topic material will differ (e.g. this website vs slide-deck)

- 2026/Oct/06 (Tuesday) - Module 1: AI in data science (Ben/Paul)

- 2026/Oct/13 (Tuesday) - Module 2: QGIS (Adrian)

- 2026/Oct/20 (Tuesday) - Module 3: Vibe-coding (Ben/Paul)

- 2026/Oct/22 (Thursday) - Module 4: eDNA (Lauren)


_
<aside>__Note:__  We will not be offended if you only attend part of a module.
